agenda_text:
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  APRIL 9, 2024
  REGULAR MEETING
  5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
  6:30 P.M. - REGULAR BUSINESS BEGINS
  IN COUNCIL CHAMBER AT 3031 TORRANCE BL.

  CITY COUNCIL MAY TAKE ACTION ON ANY ITEM LISTED ON THE AGENDA

Revised City Council Agenda 04-09-2024

*Denotes the item was added after posting of the agenda.

OPENING CEREMONIES

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  ROLL CALL
  : Councilmembers Griffiths, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, and Mayor Chen

  2)  Sling Flying Club, LLC d/b/a Sling Pilot Academy v. City of Torrance, California FAA

RECONVENED IN PUBLIC SESSION

2.  FLAG SALUTE: Councilmember Mattucci

  NONSECTARIAN INVOCATION: Councilmember Sheikh

3.  REPORT OF THE CITY CLERK ON THE POSTING OF THE AGENDA The agenda was
  posted on the Public Notice Board at 3031 Torrance Bl. and on the City’s Website on
  Tuesday, April 2, 2024 /s/ Rebecca Poirier
  3 - AFFIDAVIT

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READING OF RESOLUTIONS AND ORDINANCES AFTER
NUMBER & TITLE – See Council Rules of Order Section 2.11 (Resolution 2006-65)

4.  ANNOUNCEMENT OF WITHDRAWN, DEFERRED, AND/OR SUPPLEMENTAL ITEMS

5.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

OUTGOING CITY COUNCIL BUSINESS

6.  COMMUNITY MATTERS

  6A. Recognition of Outgoing City Councilmember Mike Griffiths.

  6B. City Clerk – Adopt RESOLUTION NO. 2024-12 Declaring the Results of Votes Cast
  at the March 5, 2024 General Municipal Election and Installation of Officers.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Clerk that City Council adopt RESOLUTION NO. 2024-12
  declaring the results of the General Municipal Election consolidated by the County of Los
  Angeles with Statewide Direct Primary Election held on March 5, 2024. The City Clerk is
  prepared to give the Oath of Office and present Certificates of Election to the elected
  officeholders. RECESS FOR RECEPTION RECONVENE – REGULAR BUSINESS OF THE
  INCOMING CITY COUNCIL
  6B - STAFF REPORT
  6B - MATERIALS AVAILABLE

RECESS FOR RECEPTION

RECONVENE- REGULAR BUSINESS OF THE INCOMING CITY COUNCIL

ROLL CALL: Councilmembers Gerson, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, and Mayor
Chen

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items under the Consent Calendar or items that
  are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on
  items raised during public comment, but may respond briefly to statements made or
  questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals
  are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no
  longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If
  presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk
  before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak
  PUBLIC COMMENT
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT RECIEVED AFTER 5:30 P.M. ON 4/08/24 AND PRIOR TO
  ADJOURMENT AT 9:22 P.M. ON 4/09/24
 RECESS

RECONVENE

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items under the Consent Calendar or items that
  are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on
  items raised during public comment, but may respond briefly to statements made or
  questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals
  are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no
  longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If
  presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk
  before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak

8.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one
  vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by
  a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..

  8A. Number Not Used.

  8B. City Manager – Approve Request for Subsidy of Rental Fees for Use of Wilson
  Park by California State Legislature on Behalf of Assemblymember Al
  Muratsuchi. Expenditure: $550 (General Fund).
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council approve a request for subsidy of
  rental fees in the amount of $550 for use of Wilson Park by the California State Legislature
  on behalf of Assemblymember Al Muratsuchi for the Earth Day Teach-In to be held on April
  27, 2024.
  8B - STAFF REPORT

  8C. Community Development – Approve Final Tract Map No. 83535 and Determine
  that the Project is Categorically Exempt by the Guidelines for Implementation of
  the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), Article 19, Section 15332.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Community Development Director that City Council:
  1) Approve Final Tract Map No. 83535; and
  2) Determine that the project is categorically exempt by the Guidelines for Implementation
  of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), Article 19, Section 15332.
  8C - STAFF REPORT

  8D. General Services – Approve First Amendment to Public Works Agreement for
  Taxiway Lights and Wire Replacement at the Torrance Municipal Airport –
  Zamperini Field. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the General Services Director that City Council approve a first
  amendment to the public works agreement with Elecnor Belco Electric, Inc. of Chino, CA
  (C2023-043) for Taxiway Lights and Wire Replacement at the Torrance Municipal Airport –
  Zamperini Field to extend the contract term from April 11, 2024 through December 31, 2024.
  8D - STAFF REPORT
  8D - SUPPLEMENTAL
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT

  8E.  Public Works – Appropriate Funds for City of Torrance Fiber Network and Traffic
  Signal Optimization, T-195. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council appropriate $599,495.39
  from the Transportation Development Impact Fee Fund’s fund balance to City of Torrance
  Fiber Network and Traffic Signal Optimization, T-195.
  8E - STAFF REPORT

9.  ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS

  9A. Public Works – Adopt RESOLUTION Approving Los Angeles Regional Safe,
  Clean Water Program Transfer Agreement, Authorize the Director of Public
   Works to Sign Agreement, and Appropriate Grant Funds to the Beach Cities
  Green Streets Project, S-194. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council:
  1) Adopt a RESOLUTION approving the Los Angeles Regional Safe, Clean Water (SCW)
  Program Transfer Agreement (Agreement) with the Los Angeles County Flood Control
  District; and
  2) Authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Agreement; and
  3) Upon execution of the Agreement, appropriate $5,366,953 of SCW Program grant
  funds to the Beach Cities Green Streets Project, S-194.
  9A - STAFF REPORT

  9B. Public Works – Approve First Amendment to Consulting Services Agreement for
  Pacific Coast Highway and Crenshaw Boulevard Intersection Improvement, T-
  143. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council approve a first amendment
  to the consulting services agreement with Psomas of Los Angeles, CA (C2022-064) for the
  Pacific Coast Highway and Crenshaw Boulevard Intersection Improvement, T-143 to extend
  the agreement term for an additional two-year period beginning April 26, 2024 and ending
  April 25, 2026.
  9B - STAFF REPORT

  9C. City Manager – Adopt RESOLUTION Setting Forth Hours, Wages, and Working
  Conditions for Fire Safety Management Employees. Expenditure: $310,108
  (General Fund: Approximately $77,527 Annually).
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council:
  1) Adopt a RESOLUTION setting forth the hours, wages, and working conditions for Fire
  Safety Management employees; and
  2) Repeal Resolution No. 2019-84 in its entirety.
  9C - STAFF REPORT

  9D. City Manager – Accept Quitclaim of Easement and Adopt RESOLUTION
  Approving Grant of Easement for Water Facilities on a Portion of City-Owned
  Property Located at 20500 Madrona Avenue. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council:
  1) Accept the Quitclaim of Easement between the City of Torrance and California Water
  Service Company on a portion of city-owned property located at 20500 Madrona
  Avenue; and
  2) Adopt a RESOLUTION approving a Grant of Easement to California Water Service
  Company for new water facilities on a portion of city-owned property located at 20500
  Madrona Avenue.
  9D - STAFF REPORT

10.  HEARINGS – None Scheduled.

RECESS AS CITY COUNCIL

RECONVENE AS BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS FOR THE PUBLIC HOUSING AGENCY

11.  AGENCY AGENDAS

  11A. Public Housing Agency (Separate Agenda)
  11A - PUBLIC HOUSING AGENCY AGENDA
  1.  Roll Call Gerson, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, and Chairman Chen
  2.  Report on Posting of Agenda
  2A - AFFIDAVIT
  3.  Approval of Minutes: September 26, 2023
  3A - STAFF REPORT
  4. Communications and Other Business
  5. Oral Communications
  6. Hearings
  6A. Public Housing Agency - Conduct Public Hearing and Approve the 2024 Annual Public
  Housing Agency (PHA) Plan and the 2024-2028 Five-Year Plan for the Section 8
  Program. Expenditure: None.
  6A - STAFF REPORT
   7.  Report of the Executive Director and Other Officers
  8.  Adjournment

RECESS AS BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS FOR THE PUBLIC HOUSING AGENCY

RECONVENE AS CITY COUNCIL

12.  2ND READING ORDINANCES

  12A. Second and Final reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3932 amending Sections 13.1.2,
  13.2.2, 13.3.2, 13.4.2, 13.5.2, 13.9.2, 13.10.2, 13.11.2(a), 13.15.2, 13.16.2, 13.18.2,
  13.20.020, and 13.21.030 all titled “Appointment and Terms of Members” and
  Sections 13.1.3, 13.2.3, 13.3.3, 13.5.3, 13.9.3, 13.15.3, 13.16.3, 13.18.3, 13.20.030,
  and 13.21.040 all titled “Filling Of Vacancies of the Torrance Municipal Code
  Relating to Appointment of Commissioners” and approve an Ordinance
  Summary for publication.
  12A - STAFF REPORT

13.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) Council Order -
  Sheikh, Gerson, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Mayor Chen This portion of the meeting
  is reserved for comments on items not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act,
  City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may respond
  briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item
  to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral
  Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you
  step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide
  11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you
  speak.

15.  ADJOURNMENT

  15A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, April 23, 2024, at 5:00 p.m. for
  closed session, with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the Leroy J.
  Jackson Council Chamber. Tuesday, April 16, 2024, is a Council Dark Night.
  15A - STAFF REPORT
